row: Bright Education is a Fort Lauderdale based Massage School that trains students for careers as a Licensed Massage Therapist or to open up your own spa practice. We have a 5 month program with day and night classes. 100% Tuition Financing is available for those who qualify. To enroll, call 754-222-6673. Make a move.
